about: Seconds each plant of scripts/negative_tests.py took, restoration included, to a tenth of a second, written by `python3 scripts/negative_tests.py --times-from-log` from the time lines of 54 plants in the log run-43213322004/negative-job-131166251991.log. `--workers N` deals the plants out by these times, longest first; a plant missing here weighs their median, and with no file every plant weighs the same. A stale time only balances the workers less well: it changes no verdict. These are the times of the merge group run 43213322004's `negative` job, 131166251991, on GitHub's free runner with four workers at once, each of its 4 cores running a worker, so each plant's time includes the contention of the other three: a record for that runner, read from the job's log with GitHub's time stamps cut from its lines.
